<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>Detects rising edges on the data_in signal and produces data_out = 1 during the falling edge after the second rising edge.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">The active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in">One-bit input signal.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Output signal indicating the detection of pulses.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        reg [2:0]state;
        
        always@(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)begin
            if(~rst_n)begin
                state <= 3'd0;
            end
            else begin
                case(state)
                    3'd0 : begin
                        if(data_in == 1'b0) state <= 3'd0;
                        else state <= 3'd1;
                    end
                    3'd1 : begin
                        if(data_in == 1'b1) state <= 3'd2;
                        else state <= 3'd1;
                    end
                    3'd2 : begin
                        if(data_in == 1'b0) state <= 3'd3;
                        else state <= 3'd2;
                    end
                    3'd3 : begin
                        if(data_in == 1'b0) state <= 3'd0;
                        else state <= 3'd1;
                    end
                    default: state <= 3'd0;
                endcase
            end
        end
        
        assign data_out = ((state == 3'd3)? 1'd1 : 1'd0);
        
    </implementation>
    
</module>
